login.title: Sign in
login.lead: This is your private tool. Only your own Google or Microsoft account can sign in.

connect.title: Connect your mailboxes
connect.lead: We read sender, subject and list headers to find companies. We don't read your email bodies.
connect.partial: Read access granted. Sending will ask for permission the first time you send.
connect.unverifiedBody: Google will show “Google hasn't verified this app”. That's expected for your own private app. Check that the app name and developer email are yours, then choose Advanced → Go to StopDisturbance.

errors.state: The sign-in link expired. Try again.
errors.missing_read_scope: Read permission is required to scan.
errors.no_refresh_token: The provider didn't return long-term access. Remove the app from your account permissions and connect again.
errors.tenant_not_allowed: Only Outlook.com/Hotmail accounts, or a Microsoft 365 organisation you administer, can be connected.
errors.no_id_token: Microsoft didn't confirm your identity. Try again.
errors.connect_failed: Something went wrong while connecting. Try again.
